description: Immediately removes a user from an organization in Zendesk. Use when you need to unassign a user from an organization membership. This action is irreversible - the user will no longer be associated with the organization.

organization_id.human_parameter_description: The numeric ID of the Zendesk organization you want to unassign the user from. You can find this in the organization record or from a previous list or search result.
organization_id.title: Organization Id

user_id.human_parameter_description: The numeric ID of the Zendesk user you want to unassign from an organization. You can find this in the user's profile URL or from a user search result.
user_id.title: User Id

name: unassign_user_organization

success.description: Indicates whether the organization unassignment was successful
success.title: Success
